pagePlan.primaryGoal: Help visitors explore food, find opening hours and visit or contact the cafe.

candidates.rationale: Photo-first terrace with retro sign composition, exact SKU dish selector, and a green menu board replacing repeated product cards.
Rejected: complete grid implies item photography unavailable for most of the menu; place identity is more distinctive.

brand.fontRationale: Bree Serif licensed display adaptation for the explicit retro warung direction; DM Sans controls/body; actual logo image retained. Not claimed as original logo font.

pagePlan.desktop: Photo-first terrace hero with framed serif sign, scene story, one product spotlight with protein/sambal radio controls, green dashed menu board with category/search, practical visit rows.
pagePlan.mobile: Full-width terrace scene and sign, one dish photo and radio options instead of repeated 2x2 grid, default Kopi subset and expandable inline search across all47 records.
pagePlan.motion: MotionConfig reducedMotion=user; reduced-motion-aware hero and product crossfade; search expansion respects prefers-reduced-motion; shadcn Select transition.
pagePlan.componentProvenance: Official shadcn base-nova RadioGroup registry (research/radio-group-registry.json), local official Input copy, existing Button/Select; @base-ui/react primitives retained.
